name: Leather Journal Set
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Premium PU leather cover with a smooth texture and elegant appearance.
    - Features a secure buckle closure with metal accent for added style and protection.
    - Includes high-quality 80 gsm beige paper, containing 100 sheets (200 pages) of high-quality 80gsm wood-free paper for comfortable writing.
    - Choose between a journal-only option or a complete gift set featuring a matching pen and elegant gift box.
                    + Journal  Only
                    + Journal Set Includes: Journal + Pen + Pen Refill + Gift Box
    - Available in multiple colors: Brown, Red, Green, Navy Blue, Grey, and Black.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Journal Size: 14.7 × 21.5 cm (5.79 × 8.46 in)
    - Page Count: 100 sheets / 200 pages
    - Paper Weight: 80gsm wood-free paper

         - Gift Box:
                + Dimensions: 9.05 x 9.05 in (~23 x 23 cm)
                + Thickness: 1.38 in (~3.5 cm)

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors and sharp image quality.
    - Supports both single-sided printing and double-sided printing.
    - Designs are highly detailed, durable, and resistant to fading over time.

 

  • Care Instructions:
    - Wipe the PU leather cover gently with a soft, dry cloth.
    - Avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight, excessive heat, or moisture.
    - Keep away from sharp objects to prevent scratches or damage to the cover.
    - Store in a cool, dry place when not in use.
    - Do not soak or wash the journal with water.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Ideal for daily journaling, note-taking, planning, sketching, and personal organization.
    - Suitable for students, professionals, writers, travelers, and creatives.
    - Helps capture ideas, memories, goals, and important notes in one elegant place.
    - The buckle closure keeps pages protected and secure during travel or storage.
    - The gift set version includes a smooth-writing pen and premium gift box, making it ready for gifting.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful and practical gift suitable for people of all ages.
    - Perfect for birthdays, graduations, anniversaries, Christmas, Father's Day, Mother's Day, Teacher Appreciation Day, retirement celebrations, and corporate gifting.
    - Personalized designs transform an everyday journal into a meaningful keepsake for family, friends, colleagues, and loved ones.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3–5 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7–15 working days average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 × Leather Journal Set

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
